item.text: Before extending opening hours, the cafe should assess whether demand goes beyond a few customers. Survey customers about preferred times and likely visit frequency, and review foot traffic and competitors’ hours. Estimate additional sales against staffing, utilities, security, and other operating costs. Check employee availability, licensing restrictions, and potential effects on service quality. A short trial could reveal actual demand and profitability. The decision should depend on sustained customer interest and whether extra revenue reliably covers the additional costs.
